name: lumi-help
description: Orient the user in their Lumina wiki workspace. Three modes: Orientation (default — recommend ONE next action; offer to run), Catalog (on `skills`/`list` arg or features question — render lumi-help.csv grouped by pack), Framework Q&A (on `explain` arg or how-it-works question — answer from local docs with citations). Use when the user says "help", "what next", "I'm lost", asks for orientation, or asks how Lumina works.
